status: offline experiment only; no activation or production writes
training_availability: observed_at and created_at strictly before each validation start; no revision history exists
primary: three running systems, strict pairing; free_level OLS is the prespecified primary candidate
secondary: two systems separately; minute approximations separately; never mix groups to claim EXPERT8 improvement
unconstrained_definition: free intercept and slope, no slope-sign constraint, input clipping, output clipping or +/-2 residual cap; no polynomial search
robust_loss: scipy least_squares Huber loss with fixed f_scale=1.5 ash percentage points; no parameter bounds
primary_score: mean of each validation date's MAE; also sample MAE, RMSE, prediction-minus-label bias and max absolute error
selection: no automatic winner or hyperparameter selection; compare fixed candidates; tail inspected once, never tune on it
sensitivity: exclude ID 63 only as explicitly labelled diagnostic
each date equal total fitting weight
strict trained model evaluated on minute approximation separately
strict plus minute approximation training separately
label_policy: exclude audit label_review/incomplete; retain 31.42% in main analysis; no corrections or deletion
lag_policy: fixed level target t-90 seconds; other factors at t; no lag or pairing-tolerance tuning
holdout_disclosure: tail feature/label quality already inspected during audit, but no fitting or model-error selection before this protocol; tiny historical tail is not prospective external validation
limitations: observational association is not causality or identified coal type
three-system strict tail has only 3 samples
constant switches cannot identify eight independent effects
created_at is initial entry, not lab report or later revision time
